filters.name: Flip Edges by Planarity
filters.shortDescription: Optimize local triangle quality by flipping nearly coplanar edges.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Mesh optimization by edge flipping, improving local triangle quality for face pairs whose dihedral angle is below the planar threshold. A small surface-preserving Laplacian relaxation can be run after the flip pass.

parameters.label: Affect only selection
parameters.help: If enabled, optimize only selected faces.

parameters.label: Planar threshold (deg)
parameters.help: Only adjacent faces whose dihedral angle is below this threshold are considered for planar optimization.

parameters.label: Planar metric
parameters.help: Metric used to rank planar edge flips.

parameters.label: Post optimization relax iter
parameters.help: Number of surface-preserving planar Laplacian smoothing iterations performed after the flip pass.

filters.name: Flip Edges by Curvature
filters.shortDescription: Optimize local triangulation by reducing discrete curvature.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Mesh optimization by edge flipping to improve local mesh curvature. The method evaluates edge flips with discrete curvature metrics and applies flips that reduce the local curvature measure.

parameters.label: Affect only selection
parameters.help: If enabled, optimize only selected faces.

parameters.label: Angle threshold (deg)
parameters.help: Only face pairs with a dihedral angle larger than this threshold are considered for curvature optimization.

parameters.label: Curvature metric
parameters.help: Metric used to evaluate curvature reduction before and after a flip.

filters.name: Smooth Vertices by Surface-Preserving Laplacian (vcglib)
filters.shortDescription: Laplacian smooth while limiting normal deviation from the original surface.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Laplacian smooth with limited surface modification: each vertex moves toward the average position of neighboring vertices only when the new position still almost lies on the original surface.

parameters.label: Affect only selection
parameters.help: If enabled, smooth only selected faces.

parameters.label: Max normal deviation (deg)
parameters.help: Maximum mean normal angle displacement allowed from old to new faces.
